summary: Sanction requirement under Section 197 CrPC for PMLA proceedings; applicability to public servants; scope of 'official duty'; act reasonably connected with duty; removal power determining public servant status; sanction needed regardless of offence nature; first respondent's status as public servant established through memorandum provisions; second respondent as Principal Secretary clearly falls under public servant; dismissal of complaints without sanction quashed; cognizance can proceed only after obtaining sanction.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.3, s.4, s.44(1)(b), s.71
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.197(1), (s.218 Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment quashing cognizance set aside; matter remanded for obtaining sanction and further proceedings under PMLA.
